comment: Body armour (VIEWMODEL_SPEC section 50). A plate carrier (blockland:vest, chest slot) holds up to `maxPlates` armour plates (blockland:armor_plate). Of a hit of a covered kind, `covers` (damage type id, or #tag) gives the share the armour takes: that share wears the plates down first, the last inserted (outermost) first, each with `plateDurability` points; a plate worn down to `replaceBelow` of that or less is swapped for the next plate put in (before a free slot is used); what gets past the plates is cut by the vest's own `vestProtection`; the rest of the hit goes straight through. `headshotsBypass`: a headshot ignores the armour. A plate goes in after `insertSeconds` (left-click with a plate in hand, the vest on), the view dipping `insertDip` degrees.
